criterion_observations.reason: The trusted package provides no evidence_refs, so there is no evidence to verify whether the test uses a fixed input and asserts the expected result. The criterion statement can only be assessed against submitted evidence; without any evidence items, the coach cannot determine support or insufficiency.

missing_evidence: A test artifact (script, notebook, or log) showing the fixed input values used in the deterministic workflow test.
Evidence of the expected output or assertion logic that the test validates against those inputs.
A run log or execution trace confirming the test was executed and the assertion passed.
revision_suggestion: Submit at least one piece of evidence that demonstrates the deterministic workflow test end-to-end: include the input data, the assertion code or expected-result definition, and an execution log showing the test ran and the assertion succeeded. This will allow the criterion to be evaluated as supported rather than unable_to_determine.
